description: Na₂MgCu₂TeO₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.72 Å. Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and two longer (2.07 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.84 Å) and one longer (1.86 Å) Cu-O bond length. Te is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.03 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Cu, and one Te atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂CuTe trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Cu, and one Te atom.
